_comment: Settings for the daily job feed (scripts/discover.py). Edit freely. See README > 'Customise the job feed' for every key.
_portals_note: naukri and foundit are India-only job boards. Remove them if you search in another country.
_allowed_locations_note: Non-remote jobs whose location contains none of these words are skipped before scoring. Use [] to allow any location.

candidate.about: Fresher (0 years of experience), open to internships and full-time roles.
candidate.location_rule: Anywhere in India, or remote from India. Onsite roles outside India don't work.

_alumni_note: Add your college's full and short names, e.g. ["Example Institute of Technology", "EIT"], to find alumni at each company. Leave empty to skip.
referral_message: Hi {first}, I'm {me}. I saw the {role} opening at {company}. I've built {pitch}. Would you be open to referring me, or pointing me to the right person? Happy to share my resume. Thank you!
